I want to ask my boss for a raise but I have no idea how to bring it up.
Honestly, the opener matters less than people think - just ask for a specific time to talk about compensation directly, don't bury it in a casual chat.
What if they say no though?
Then ask what would need to change for a yes, actually - a 'no' without a path forward is a dead end, but most managers will give you criteria if you ask directly.

That's a really common and painful realization. It doesn't mean the feelings weren't real, just that they were pointed at someone who didn't fully exist. The harder part is usually grieving the version you imagined, separately from the actual person.

What's the actual difference between guilt and shame psychologically?

Guilt is about behavior: "I did a bad thing." Shame is about identity: "I am a bad person." That distinction matters a lot for how each one functions.

Guilt tends to be more useful — it points at a specific action, which means it can actually motivate repair: apologizing, changing the behavior, making amends. It has a natural exit once the behavior is addressed.

Shame is stickier and less useful. Because it attacks identity rather than behavior, it doesn't point toward any clear fix — you can't 'fix' being a bad person the way you can fix a specific action. This is often why shame leads to withdrawal, defensiveness, or hiding, while guilt leads to accountability.

A lot of emotional growth work is actually about learning to convert shame responses back into guilt responses — separating "I am bad" from "I did something that needs repairing."

notun creator der jonno first 90 din er ekta realistic roadmap dite paro bistarito?

Obviously প্রতিটা niche আলাদা, kintu general structure ta ami share korte pari. First 30 din: consistency establish kora shobcheye important, quality niye eto worry na kore posting rhythm build kora - daily na parle, ekta fixed weekly schedule thik kore sheta strictly follow kora। Ei phase e engagement kom thakবেই, eta normal, discourage howar dorkar nai. Next 30 din (31-60): audience feedback dekhe adjust kora shuru kora - kon content type beshi response pacche, kon time e post korle better reach hocche, eishob pattern notice kora। Personally amar mote ei phase tai shobcheye important, karon ekhane creator der beshi mane experiment kore data er base e, guess kore na. Last 30 din (61-90): ekta clearer content identity establish howa uchit - ekta specific angle ba style ja audience associate korte pare tomar sathe. Ei somoy e first monetization step gulo o start kora jete pare jodi audience base thik thake, jemon tip jar/small subscription tier। Sotti bolte, 90 din e clear success dekha jabe emon guarantee kew dite parbe na, kintu ei structure follow korle at least ekta clear, measurable progress dekha jabe, random effort er cheye onek better.
